messages:
marcus: Heads-up: we need to finalize alerting + pager mapping for the new runtime metrics dashboard. Focus: routing policies for infra vs platform oncall, SLO burn rate thresholds, and per-team quota knobs.

aline: +1. I put together a draft of the key signals we should surface: 
- runtime_request_latency_seconds{quantile=\"0.5\"} p50/p95
- runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket (for histograms)
- runtime_token_throughput_total (tokens/sec)
- gpu_utilization_percent per-pool
- kv_cache_miss_rate (prefix-keyed)
- model_fallback_count (counts of fallback to smaller model)
- queue_length_by_pool

samir: Suggest we separate alerts into \"page\" vs \"notify\":
- Page (critical): sustained SLO burn OR GPU saturation + increasing queue length.
- Notify (warning): p95 spikes short-lived, cache miss bursts, minor throughput degradation.

jess: Agree. Can we define concrete rules? For example for SLO burn: when burn rate over 5 min > 1.5 AND error_budget_used > 0.1? Need to be precise.

aline: Draft rule (PromQL) for critical SLO burn:
```
(sum by(service) (increase(slo_consumed_errors_total[5m])) / sum by(service) (increase(slo_allowed_errors_total[5m]))) > 1.5
```
This is rough — maybe better to use burn rate metric we already export: slo_burn_rate{service=~\"runtime.*\"} > 1.5 for 5m.

marcus: For GPU saturation, propose: page when gpu_utilization_percent >= 90% for 3m AND queue_length_by_pool > 10. We really want to avoid noisy pages for short spikes.

leo: How do we map pages to PD services? We should route: runtime-production -> infra-oncall, runtime-dedicated -> platform-dedicated-oncall, runtime-private -> customer-ops (manual PD). Also fallback to on-call lead if no ack in 5m.

samir: I can create PD services and escalation policies. Need final list of alert names, severity labels, and target PD services. Also confirm whether we use the same PD routing in EU region.

jess: Also important: dashboards should include owner links and runbook links. If alert fires, PD page should include runbook URL and quick triage checklist. Example runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/runtime/slow-p95

aline: One more: per-team quotas. If a tenant is throttled because of quota limit, we should emit quota_throttles_total{tenant=~\".*\"} and notify the owning product team (no page). Pages only when global pool impacts are detected.

marcus: Timeline: samir to provision PD services + policies by EOD Wed, aline to add alerting rules to prometheus repo and dashboards by Fri, jess to add runbooks + map owners by next Tue. Anyone object?

samir: I also want to propose a night-time severity dampening window for non-critical warnings (23:00-06:00). Critical pages still go through. Thoughts?

leo: Fine with dampening for notify-only alerts. Add annotation to rule: annotation: suppress_window = 23:00-06:00. Keep critical alerts unaffected.

deploy-bot: deploy: alerting/rules/runtime/merged -> staging at 2026-03-18T14:02:10Z :white_check_mark:

aline: Quick snippet for alert rule (YAML friendly):
```yaml
- alert: RuntimeSLOBurnCritical
  expr: slo_burn_rate{service=~\"runtime.*\"} > 1.5
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical
    team: runtime
  annotations:
    summary: \"Runtime SLO burn >1.5 for {{ $labels.service }}\"
    runbook: \"https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/runtime/slo-burn\"
```

marcus: Action items recap: 
- samir: create PD services + escalation (deadline Wed EOD)
- aline: add rules + dashboards PR (deadline Fri)
- jess: write runbooks + owner mapping (deadline Tue)
- leo: confirm routing for EU & private PD mapping

jess: I'll also add a note in the Console UX rollout doc about including the \"alerting\" toggle per dashboard so teams can opt-out of noisy warnings during experiments.

samir: I'll create PD services now, will post back with IDs.

marcus: thanks all. I'll follow up in eng-platform tomorrow with final mapping and include a small table for PD -> escalation policy. :thumbsup:

leo: thanks — marking this thread for ops sync on Fri.

marcus: closing loop: please update the PRs with the PD service IDs so we can wire link in annotations.

aline: noted — will include PD IDs in PR description.

samir: PD services created: PD-RTN-PROD (infra-oncall), PD-RTN-DED (platform-dedicated), PD-RTN-PRIVATE (customer-ops). Posting policies in a follow-up message.

marcus: perfect, that should let us wire alerts cleanly.
